subject: Request: data-handling affidavit + transit map for temporary EdgeStream agent

Subject: Quick ask — temporary agent (EdgeStream) data flows and affidavit

Hi Karthik,

We’re finalizing the integration scope for our pilot with EdgeStream (temporary analytics agent) and Legal Ops asked me to get a couple of artifacts before we proceed:

- A current subprocessor list (including country of processing and whether any processor stores or exports EU-personal data)
- A short data-handling affidavit that states the transient nature of data that flows through EdgeStream and retention/escrow commitments for analytics snapshots
- A transit map (high level) that shows cross-border hops for telemetry collected as part of this integration

Can you share those items or point me to a contact who can? Our procurement team needs them for the DPA addendum and they’re on a fairly tight timeline (targeting the week of June 23).

I attached a brief questionnaire we use to standardize requests — filling the first two pages will be sufficient for now.

Thanks,
Aimee

Karthik / Marissa / Aimee — attached is the current subprocessor list specific to EdgeStream telemetry processing. Quick notes inline:

- edge-agent-proc (US): sheerly transient buffering — no persistent storage of customer data; processes in us-west only
- telemetry-relay (IE): aggregates telemetry for batching, occasional short-term persistence (24 hrs) — EU data may be processed in Ireland; export only to onshore fallback in US if EU region unavailable
- analytics-pool (US/TW): anonymized summaries for product analytics; contains no raw PII per our transformation rules

I’m attaching the CSV export of the subprocessor inventory and a draft affidavit (first-pass) — please review. Marissa, I left a couple of "ops questions" on the transit map column you can pick up.

Attachments: edge-stream-subprocessor-list.csv, data_handling_affidavit_draft.pdf

Kimberly

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-06-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — temporary agent (EdgeStream) data flows and affidavit

Aimee — attaching the transit map (v1) and a short ops note on fallback behavior.

Highlights:
- Primary path: Edge (EU edge node) -> telemetry-relay (IE) -> analytics-pool (US)
- Onshore fallback: if telemetry-relay in IE is unavailable, data streams route to onshore relay in us-central for buffering; purged within 24 hours unless a retention hold is requested
- Retention/escrow: snapshots used for debugging are redacted and retained for max 7 days; we can agree to a stricter 48-hour window for pilot customers on request

I also added a short paragraph to the affidavit draft confirming the temporary nature and our ability to bind subprocessors by DPA/contract. If FinovatePay wants the affidavit executed via DocuSign, Karthik — let me know and I’ll route to Legal for signature.

Attachments: transit-map-v1.svg

Thanks,
Marissa
